audience.text: Java developers building server-side or desktop applications that require PDF document generation, manipulation, and extraction without third-party runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create PDFs from scratch using Document and Page APIs, add paragraphs, tables, and text fragments, and save to file or stream.
capabilities.title: Create and edit PDF documents

capabilities.text: Extract plain text using TextAbsorber and images using XImage from existing PDF documents page by page.
capabilities.title: Extract text and images

capabilities.text: Fill AcroForm fields, add and modify widget annotations, radio button options, and border styles using Form and Annotation APIs.
capabilities.title: Work with forms and annotations

capabilities.text: Render PDF pages to raster images using device classes and convert to/from HTML and XML using save options.
capabilities.title: Render and convert pages

capabilities.text: Encrypt documents with AES/RC4, sign with PKCS#7, and optimize resources using built-in security and optimization APIs.
capabilities.title: Secure and optimize documents

capabilities.text: Build and inspect document outlines, bookmarks, and tagged PDF structure trees using dedicated APIs.
capabilities.title: Manage document structure

limitations.text: No OCR support; text recognition in scanned images requires a dedicated OCR library.
No conversion to non-PDF formats beyond HTML/XML; DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, and similar are unsupported.
Concurrency is not supported for a single Document instance; use one Document per thread for parallel processing.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic PDF creation, text extraction, form filling, annotation handling, and page operations using a single pure-Java dependency with no external runtime libraries.
Supports ISO 32000-1:2008-compliant PDF processing including AcroForm fields, annotations, digital signatures, encryption, and PDF/A conversion.
Provides document optimization, resource management, and conversion to/from HTML/XML and raster formats for integration into document workflows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java library for creating, reading, and modifying PDF documents compliant with ISO 32000-1:2008.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Build the project with 'mvn package' and run tests with 'mvn -B clean test' using JUnit 5 in CI pipelines defined under .github/workflows/.

workflows.name: Release to Maven Central
workflows.text: Releases are published to Maven Central via the maven-central-release.yml workflow, targeting Java 11 and version 26.9.0.

workflows.name: Create and modify PDFs
workflows.text: Developers instantiate Document, add pages with Page, insert text via TextFragment, and save to PDF using doc.save().

workflows.name: Extract content
workflows.text: Extract text using TextAbsorber, images using XImage, and form field values using Form and Field APIs.
